title: Swidget's Offset Mod
description: A lightweight Java Fabric 1.21.11 mod that adds customizable item offsets to improve PvP visuals and screen positioning. Fine-tune how weapons, tools, and other held items appear in first person for a cleaner and more comfortable combat experience.
body: This Fabric 1.21.11 mod adds customizable first-person item offsets designed for PvP gameplay. It allows you to change the position, rotation, and scale of held items so your screen feels cleaner and less obstructed during combat. The mod supports a wide range of Minecraft items, including swords, tools, consumables, and more. Built to be lightweight and simple to configure, it helps players create a more comfortable and personalized PvP experience without changing vanilla gameplay mechanics.
